newsitem.title: JAPAN: AOL chairman says no comment on merger rumours.
newsitem.headline: AOL chairman says no comment on merger rumours.

text.p: America Online Inc chairman Steve Case told reporters in Tokyo on Monday that he would not comment on market rumours of merger talks with CompuServe Corp, an affiliate of H&R Block Inc.
"We never comment on market rumours," he said.

Case, in Tokyo to announce the launch of AOL's online service in Japan, said he expected AOL to post a small loss in the January-March period of 1997, but to return to profitability in the second quarter.
"The general expectation is that we will have a slight loss in the first quarter, and we will generate profit in the April-June quarter," he said.
Case added that he expects Japan to become the largest market outside of the United States for AOL's online services.
He added he expects similar growth in Japan to what the company has experienced in the United States, where AOL now has five million customers, up from 200,000 five years ago.
